app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 - The public members endpoint takes limit and offset from the client without bounds.. `limit` and `offset` come straight from params. A negative value (e.g. `offset=-1`) makes Postgres reject the query, which gives a 500. `limit=0` is echoed back in `meta.limit`, and the client stores it and divides by it in `currentPage`, `totalPages` and `next`, so the page counts become NaN or Infinity. A very large limit lets any viewer of a group load all of its members in one request. Clamp both values, e.g. `limit = [[limit, 1].max, 200].min` and `offset = [offset, 0].max`.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 - Adding a user who is already a member returns a 500 error.. `add_members` calls `group.add(user)` for every username without checking whether the user is already in the group. app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:30 - Overlapping findMembers responses can leave the wrong page displayed. `findMembers` writes `offset`, `limit`, `user_count` and `members` onto the shared Group model from whichever response arrives last. `next` and `previous` change `offset` and send a new request right away, and nothing cancels or ignores the earlier request. If an admin clicks quickly, or an add/remove reload overlaps a page change, an older response can arrive last and overwrite the newer state, so the members shown do not match the page counter the user expects. Fix: keep a request counter and ignore any response that is not from the latest request.
